_meta.description: Curated inventory of YouTube videos relevant to Flame Python scripting, API, Wiretap SDK, and CLI tools — for Phase D transcript extraction
_meta.scraping_notes: Exhaustive inventory after keyword search + browser verification on both channels. Logik Live: 233 total videos, ~37 Python-relevant selected. FLC: 640 total videos; Python Scripting playlist (6 available + 1 unavailable) is the only Python-specific content — all 7 included.

tiers.HIGH: Direct Python scripting tutorials, hands-on code demos
tiers.MEDIUM: Python-adjacent tools, pipeline automation, ShotGrid integration

episodes.title: Writing Python Scripts for Flame with Andy Milkis and Frederic Warren
episodes.notes: Foundational episode — beginner to intermediate Python scripting for Flame. Covers the range of what is possible with the Flame Python API.

episodes.title: Python Scripts and the Uppercut Workflow with John Geehreng
episodes.notes: Real-world production automation — Uppercut (NYC) workflow. Project creation, shot publishing, renaming, Frame.io integration, delivery.

episodes.title: Simple Python Scripts with Bryan Bayley
episodes.notes: Practical beginner scripts — append start frame to clip name, source timecode manipulation.

episodes.title: Python Fun with Andrew Miller and Erik Borzi
episodes.notes: Most recent dedicated Python episode. Andrew Miller (MTI Film) and Erik Borzi. Covers newer API features.

episodes.title: Introducing Logik Projekt - The Flame Pipeline for Everyone with Phil Man
episodes.notes: Logik Projekt is an open-source Python pipeline solution for Flame by Phil Man. Handles project creation, shot structure, publishing. Key example of a complete Python-based Flame pipeline.

episodes.title: Logik.tv - Python Script to change the color of segments in the timeline
episodes.notes: Short demo clip (~3 min). Timeline segment color manipulation via Python. Drop into /opt/Autodesk/shared/python, rescan hooks.

episodes.title: Flame TWML with Andriy Toloshny & RunwayML Green Screen with Cristobal Valenzuela
episodes.notes: Andriy Toloshny presents the python-based ML Timewarp Tool for Flame (TWML). Demonstrates how Python is used to integrate external ML models into Flame workflows.

episodes.title: How I'm Using AI & ML in Flame with Andy Milkis
episodes.notes: Andy Milkis (key Flame Python developer) discusses AI/ML tools built with Python for Flame. Likely covers Python integration patterns for external models.

episodes.title: Introducing AI / ML Head Tracking with Headcase & WrapIt with Eric Levy
episodes.notes: Python-based head tracking tool built by VFX artist Eric Levy (not a developer). Shows artist-level Python tool development for Flame.

episodes.title: Using Shotgun with Flame with Alan Latteri, Jesse Morrow, and Alex Arce
episodes.notes: Instinctual (LA) shows Shotgun/ShotGrid integration with Flame. Pipeline automation and shot tracking context relevant to Python-based pipelines.

episodes.title: Publishing Workflows 101 with Josh Laurence
episodes.notes: Publishing workflow fundamentals — openclip, small archives, automated render delivery. Relevant to understanding the workflow Python scripts automate.

episodes.title: Advanced Publishing for Commercial Online Conform with Jeff Kyle
episodes.notes: Advanced publishing techniques for online conform. Connected Conform workflow updates. Context for Python publishing automation.

episodes.title: Interview with Will Harris & Yann Laforest

flame_learning_channel.description: Official Autodesk Flame Learning Channel. Short, didactic tutorials covering Flame features per release.

episodes.title: Python Scripting - OpenClip and Watch Folders
episodes.notes: First Python scripting episode on the official channel. Covers watch folder automation and OpenClip workflow via Python. RAG gap filler for watch_folders (0 chunks in current corpus).

episodes.title: Python Scripting - Batch Iteration and Render Naming
episodes.notes: Batch automation and render output naming via Python. Directly relevant to batch group scripting patterns.

episodes.notes: Updated Python scripting overview for Flame 2018.2. Covers new hooks and API additions in that release cycle.

episodes.title: Adding Custom Menu Actions
episodes.notes: Creating custom menu actions via Python hooks. Core pattern for building Flame tools. RAG gap filler for custom_menus.
